# Project Design Context: Abhiyukth Vlogs

Generated from project sources at 2026-11-06T16:30:00.000Z.

## Project

- Name: Abhiyukth Vlogs (Official Creator & Gaming Website)
- Product type: Gaming Creator Portfolio & Live Stream Hub
- Stack: Vite + Vanilla Modern JS + Three.js
- Color mode: Dark (Futuristic Cyber Gaming Universe)
- Primary Color: Neon Purple (`#8B5CF6`)
- Secondary Color: Electric Cyan (`#22D3EE`)
- Accent Color: YouTube Red (`#FF0033`)
- Background: Premium Dark Gaming Theme (`#070911` / `#05050A`)

## 3D Hero Redesign

- **Style**: Futuristic Gaming Universe
- **Main 3D Hero Object**: Sculpted procedural DualSense PS5 controller with authentic two-tone ceramic white & midnight black finish, curved dynamic LED lightbar, textured analog thumbsticks, and PlayStation action buttons.
- **Orbital Universe**: Dual holographic gyroscopic gimbal rings with orbiting energy nodes, floating quantum crystal relics, and 200+ cosmic additive glow particles.
- **Interactivity**: Fluid pointer parallax, 360° tactile drag rotation with inertia damping, and scroll-depth dolly.

## 21st.dev Component Integration

- **21st.dev Glare HUD Card**: Interactive 3D viewport featuring pointer-responsive radial glare spotlight (`--glare-x`, `--glare-y`).
- **Sci-Fi HUD Corner Brackets**: Glowing cyan/purple framing corners defining the viewport container.
- **Holographic Telemetry HUD Bar**: Real-time status indicators (`ONLINE // 60 FPS`, mode indicator, and geolocation coordinates).
- **Glowing Metric Cards**: Glassmorphic stats strip with responsive hover border glow and subtle 3D lift.
- **Cyber Holographic Badge**: Animated border gradient shimmer pill for hero badge.

## Constraints & Requirements

### Must
- Preserve all YouTube features, including live subscriber counter, YouTube Shorts discovery, catalog videos, live streams, and playlists.
- Zero-friction performance across mobile, tablet, laptop, and desktop viewports.
- Non-blocking vertical scrolling on mobile touch screens (`touch-action: pan-y`).
- Graceful WebGL fallback card and full support for `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Production build clean with no errors.
